output.review_comment: Critical issues: (1) Missing explicit import of `Fraction` - the diff must show it being added at the top of the file, or the code will fail with NameError. (2) The tiebreaker logic was fundamentally reversed from "larger headcount" to "smaller headcount" without explanation. This seems like logic tailored to satisfy the tests rather than implementing the agreed spec. The original docstring explicitly documented "larger headcount" winning ties, so this reversal needs clear justification. (3) No PR description provided - the changes lack context explaining why such a significant behavioral change was necessary. Before merging, clarify whether the tiebreaker reversal reflects the actual agreed spec or is just fitting the tests, add the missing import, and document the reasoning.
